notes.title: Almost there
notes.content:
[b]Hi![/b]

We're almost in December. Getting closer and closer to the release date!
Can't wait to share this little gem with you all.

Here's some stuff that made it into the latest build:

[list]
[*] Performance optimization
[*] Players can now see themselves, both in mirror and just by looking down
[*] Menus are now a little easier to navigate
[/list]

[i]//swezus[/i]
